description: This file defines a class CheckResponsesCost that polls a database table for response jobs, checks their completion status via litellm, and updates their status accordingly. It handles cost tracking for responses in a language model system.

classes.name: CheckResponsesCost
classes.description: A class that polls response jobs, checks their status via litellm, and updates their database status, primarily for cost tracking and response completion.

methods.name: check_responses_cost
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the status of response jobs, updates their status in the database if completed or failed, and logs the process.
